falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom saw lower highs for 3 weeks post-trough; an immediate breakout to new highs breaks the structural similarity and suggests this is not a bottom but a bear market rally or different regime entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression to pre-correction levels would falsify the bottom formation, as August 2024's bottom featured elevated volatility for 2+ weeks post-low; this signals complacency inconsistent with a genuine capitulation bottom and suggests the 'HOLD' signal is masking ongoing risk accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below 5,200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of flight-to-safety in bonds with continued equity weakness invalidates the pattern match because August 2024's bottom saw yields rise with equities (reflation/recovery pricing); a breakdown into recessionary pricing dynamics proves the macro engine is misidentifying the regime

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
